# Unbound Scene Context

Every Unbound stub in Binding Codex with its **whole scene**, in the order the player reads it: 43 scenes, 56 stubs.

*Generated by `node tools/stub_context.mjs` from the game's event data. Don't edit this file by hand; rerun the script after changing a scene. The writing notes come from `UNBOUND_GUIDE.md`.*

## How to read this

- Each scene shows the lines leading up to the stub, every choice (the one that leads to your scene is marked), and the **Gentle** and **Steamy** lines.
- On Unbound the player sees the **Steamy** line first, then yours. Pick up where it leaves off.
- Lines marked *(only if …)* appear in some playthroughs only. Don't lean on them in your text.
- Write your lines into the stub in the file named in the section heading. Search for the stub id.

## Base game (`js/story.js`)

### calla_first_night

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *"Sit beside her."*: Calla's first night out of the cells, on the library roof under the sky she'd forgotten. Very tender, very tentative. She keeps asking "is this allowed?" This is her first real choice in years, so make every step of it hers.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**The scene:**

- **Narration:** Calla's first night out of the cells, and she can't sleep in a bed. Too soft. Too much ceiling. You find her on the library roof, wrapped in a borrowed coat in your colors, staring at the actual sky.
- **Calla:** It's so big. Mother kept us underground mostly. I forgot it went up this far.
- **Narration:** She shifts over on the slates to make room. An invitation she is trying very hard to make look like an accident.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **Sit beside her.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** You sit. Her shoulder finds yours by degrees, like she's testing whether the world will punish her for it. It doesn't.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** You sit. She leans in by careful degrees until her head is on your shoulder and her cold fingers have found their way under your sleeve, tracing the warm edge of your mark like it's a hearth she's been allowed near. "Is this allowed?" she asks, barely a breath. You answer by turning your face into her hair. She shivers, and not from the cold.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `calla_first_night`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
    - **Calla:** (eventually, mumbling) Thank you for not letting me rot.
  - **"Come inside. You'll freeze." Offer her your hand.**
    - **Narration:** She takes it immediately — then looks at your joined hands like she isn't sure whose idea that was.
    - **Calla:** You're very used to people doing what you say.
    - **Calla:** (a small, crooked smile — the first one) ...I think I might be very used to it too. Eventually.
- *(Chronicle entry: "Calla's first night outside. She found the sky again.")*

### rue_romance

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *"Put her in her place."*: Rue loses a fight on purpose and admits, once, that she likes being put in her place. The brat going quiet is the beat. Her tail winds around your wrist, she runs hot as a forge, and the bookshelf literally smokes. Her brand flares if she lies, so she can't pretend she didn't want this.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**The scene:**

- **Narration:** Rue picks a fight with you on purpose, in the middle of the reading room, about whether demons can be cold. She loses it on purpose, too, and ends up pinned against a bookshelf by nothing but your stare.
- **Rue:** (breathless, grinning, trying very hard not to be) This is the part where you put me in my place, right? That's the bit. That's what we do.
- **Rue:** ...I like that part. I'm never going to say it again, so you'd better have heard it.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **Put her in her place.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** You tilt her chin up with one finger. She goes quiet in a way you've never heard from her — and then, softly, she leans into your hand.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** You tilt her chin up with one finger and hold her there, and the brat goes out of her all at once like a snuffed wick. Her tail winds around your wrist, tight and possessive; her breath is hot as a forge against your mouth before you've even closed the distance. When you finally kiss her, she makes a sound like something infernal surrendering, and the bookshelf behind her starts, very gently, to smoke.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `rue_romance`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
  - **Kiss her forehead and walk away.**
    - **Rue:** (to your retreating back, outraged, delighted) You CAN'T just — that's — I'm going to steal ALL your socks!

### isolde_romance

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *"Take her hands in yours."*: She takes off her gauntlets for the first time and shows you the warlock-slayer brands burned into her palms. Devotion through action, few words. Cold armor, warm knight. The scene is about her being touched by the hands she was ashamed of.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**The scene:**

- **Narration:** Late watch. Isolde is polishing a blade that is already clean, which Vesper says means she is troubled. You sit down beside her. She stops.
- **Isolde:** I have never removed my gauntlets in front of anyone.
- **Narration:** Slowly, one buckle at a time, she does. Her hands are scarred across both palms: the Order's warlock-slayer brands, burned in when she was a girl.
- **Isolde:** I hid them because I was ashamed. (she holds them out to you, open) I would rather you see them than not be touched by them.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **Take her hands in yours.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** You lace your fingers through hers, brands and all. Isolde makes a sound you have never heard from her — small, unguarded — and bows her forehead to your joined hands.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** You lace your fingers through hers, brands and all, and bring her scarred knuckles to your lips. Isolde goes absolutely still — and then, with the same terrible care she gives to every vow, she draws you in by the hands until there is no watch and no Order and no space between you at all. Her armor is cold. She is not. She kisses you like a knight who has decided, finally, what she is willing to die for, and is relieved beyond words that it is this.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `isolde_romance`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
  - **"Your hands are mine now. Brands and all."**
    - **Isolde:** (barely audible) Yes.
    - **Narration:** She does not let go of you for the rest of the watch.
- *(Chronicle entry: "Isolde took off her gauntlets in front of you.")*

### vesper_romance

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *1 · "Don't." (she asked you not to ask permission)*: Vesper's 300 years of patience running out. She's the archivist who's never been on the page, and the Binding at full strength means she *feels* what you feel; use that. Ink-stained fingers, the brass buttons of her coat, every candle leaning toward you. She stays witty right up until she can't.
- *2 · "Ask anyway, softly."*: The same night, but she leads: "she has been waiting a long time to be first at something." Tender, startled, a little bossy. The ink marks she leaves along your jaw and won't let you wash off.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**The scene:**

- **Narration:** The sigil on Vesper's wrist has been warm for days. Tonight it is glowing — visibly, through her sleeve — and she has stopped pretending not to notice.
- **Vesper:** At full strength, the Binding lets me feel what you feel. From across the city. (she laughs, low) I've read three hundred years of other people's pacts. I've never once been on the page.
- **Vesper:** I'm starving for someone who doesn't ask permission. (she meets your eyes) So don't.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **Don't.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** You take her face in your hands and kiss her, and every candle in the Codex leans toward you at once.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** You take her by the collar of her archivist's coat and kiss her against the stacks, and every candle in the Codex leans toward you at once. Her ink-stained fingers find the brass buttons of her own coat before you can; she is laughing against your mouth, breathless, shaking with three centuries of patience finally running out. The sigil at her wrist blazes. She can feel exactly how much you want her. It is, she tells you later, far too much information, and she would like all of it again.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `vesper_romance`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
  - **Ask anyway, softly.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **Vesper:** (a startled, helpless laugh) Oh, you absolute — yes. Obviously yes.
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** She kisses you first. She has been waiting a long time to be first at something.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** She kisses you first, hard, ink on her fingertips leaving dark marks along your jaw that she will refuse to let you wash off in the morning. Between the stacks, by one candle, the Keeper of the Codex finally claims something for herself.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `vesper_romance`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
- **THE CODEX:** [ The Chronicle writes a new page, all on its own, and then — for the first time in its history — closes itself politely. ]

### calla_revisit

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**Tags:** captor/captive roleplay (negotiated)

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *(top)*: Negotiated captor/captive roleplay. Her terms: the old cell, **your** colors, nothing on her throat (no brand imagery, ever), stop word **"sister."** The door stays open the whole time and she never looks at it. Play the defiant envoy melting into wanting it, and land on choice.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**Earlier — the negotiation** (`calla_negotiate`, plays first; the revisit only happens if the player agreed):

- **Calla:** Can I say something strange? (she's turning a cup in her hands) The Undercroft was the worst time of my life. It was also the first time anyone ever looked at me like I mattered enough to keep.
- **Calla:** I want to go back down there with you. Not for real. A game. Where I know I can leave, and I choose not to.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **"Tell me exactly what you want. And give me a word that stops everything."**
    - **Calla:** The old cell. Your colors, not the Coven's. No brand, nothing on my throat, ever. And the word is "sister." If I say it, it's over and you just hold me.
    - **Narration:** You agree, and you ask her what else, and you listen to all of it. When she's done, she looks lighter than you've ever seen her.
  - **"Not like that. Not with us."**
    - **Calla:** (a relieved little laugh) No, that's — good. That's probably the right answer. Thank you for not laughing.
  - **"Ask me again another night."**
    - **Calla:** (a small nod) Another night.

**The scene:**

- **Calla:** Your colors. Nothing on my throat. "Sister." (she takes your hand on the Undercroft stair) I'm choosing this.
- **Narration:** The old cell door stands open the whole time. She never once looks at it.
- **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** It ends with her head in your lap on the cell floor, the door wide open, laughing at how much she didn't want to leave.
- **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** You play the warlock and she plays the defiant envoy, and somewhere in the game the defiance melts into something hungry and certain and entirely hers — the open door behind her, your colors on her shoulders, her own choice in every breath.
- ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `calla_revisit`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
- *(Chronicle entry: "Calla went back down to the Undercroft, by choice.")*

### seris_romance

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**Tags:** dominance, humiliation, breeding

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *1 · "Make her say it."* · dominance, humiliation (her losing face), breeding: The rival who keeps losing asks to lose *properly*. Her composure cracking is the whole point: make her say she wants it, then say it again. She keeps "notes" after, in a shaking hand.
- *2 · "Pull her down beside you."* · same: Softer: Seris stops narrating and just lets herself be wanted.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**The scene:**

- **Narration:** Seris has stopped pretending the duels are about anything but this. Tonight she comes to your room still in her sparring leathers, chin high, every inch the College's instrument.
- **Seris:** I lose to you. Every time. I've run the numbers; it isn't chance. (her voice drops) I would like, just once, to lose properly. To you. On purpose. And I would like you to make me admit I wanted to.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **Make her say it.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **Seris:** (a long silence; her composure cracks like glass) ...I want to. I want you. There. Recorded.
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** You hold her gaze until she looks away first — and then she laughs, unsteady, and lets you pull her close, the College's instrument finally off duty.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** You make her say it twice, slowly, until the proud line of her shoulders gives and she is pressing her flushed face into your neck, all that precision undone. She keeps very meticulous notes, later, in a hand that will not stay steady. You read them over her shoulder. She lets you.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `seris_romance`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
  - **Pull her down beside you instead.** ← **leads to your scene**
    - **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** She tenses — then melts, all at once, like a held breath released, and spends the night not calculating anything at all.
    - **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** She tenses, then melts against you all at once, and for once in her life Seris Val stops narrating and simply lets herself be wanted, thoroughly, until the candles gutter out.
    - ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `seris_romance`. They play right after the Steamy line above.

### mira_vane_revisit

**When:** Plays at camp, between rooms on an expedition.

**Tags:** bondage

**What to write** (from the guide):

- *(top)* · bondage (as free ally only): Her terms: **silk, not iron**, wrists only, frequent check-ins, stop word **"forge."** The forge-chains were her worst memory, so the scene is about surrender she *chose*, held still by someone who'd let go the second she asked. She laughs and says keep going.

**Tokens you can use:** Pronouns for the player: `{they}` `{them}` `{their}` `{They}` `{Their}`, and verb helpers `{s}` `{is}` `{has}` `{was}`.

**Earlier — the negotiation** (`mira_vane_negotiate`, plays first; the revisit only happens if the player agreed):

- **Mira Vane:** I want to ask you something, and I want you to hear all of it before you answer.
- **Mira Vane:** The forge-chains were the worst thing that ever happened to me. But being held — being held still, by someone I chose, who'd let go the second I asked — I think about that. A lot. With you.
- **▸ The player chooses:**
  - **"Tell me exactly what you want. And give me a word that stops everything."**
    - **Mira Vane:** (a slow, steadying breath) Silk, not iron. My wrists only. You check on me. And the word is "forge." I say it, everything stops, no questions.
    - **Narration:** You repeat it back to her: silk, wrists, check in, "forge." She nods, and some old tension in her shoulders lets go.
    - **Mira Vane:** Not tonight. I wanted to say it out loud first. I wanted to see your face when I did. (she smiles) Thank you for asking what I wanted.
  - **"Not like that. Not with us."**
    - **Mira Vane:** (she nods, a little embarrassed, a little relieved) That's okay. Truly. Thank you for answering honestly.
  - **"Ask me again another night."**
    - **Mira Vane:** (a small nod) Another night.

**The scene:**

- **Mira Vane:** Silk. Wrists. "Forge." (she holds out her hands, steady) I'm sure.
- **Narration:** You check the knot twice. She watches you do it, and something in her face goes very soft.
- **[Gentle only]** **Narration:** She asks you to hold her afterward with the silk still on, and you do, and she falls asleep with her head on your chest, free in every way that matters.
- **[Steamy — Unbound players see this too]** **Narration:** Bound by your hands and her own choice, Mira Vane discovers what it is to surrender without being taken — breathless, trusting, saying your name instead of the word that would stop it. You check on her. She laughs, the first truly unguarded laugh you've ever heard from her, and tells you to keep going.
- ✍️ **YOUR UNBOUND LINES GO HERE** — stub `mira_vane_revisit`. They play right after the Steamy line above.
- *(Chronicle entry: "Mira Vane chose the silk.")*
